title: Two people editing one long application form
summary: Let a founder and an accountant fill in one long form together, without losing each other's work.
context: Jalebi Pay onboards merchants through a loan application with about 200 fields across eight sections. A founder fills in part of it and the accountant does the rest, often at the same time, sometimes on a train with a poor connection.
Today, the last save wins. Merchants have lost an hour's work to this, and some field values depend on others, such as turnover deciding which documents are needed.
must_handle: Each person sees the other's changes without a reload.
Nobody loses typed text to someone else's save.
Work typed during a dropped connection survives.
A field that depends on another updates correctly when that one changes.
Everyone can see who changed what, for the lender's records.
show_in_answer: What is saved, how often, and at what granularity.
How a conflict on one field is settled, and what the person sees.
How a change reaches the other person's browser.
How the form behaves through a dropped connection.
